distributionDecisions.node: The Node entrypoint reconstructs full City objects lazily from the single compact city asset instead of publishing the 89 MB canonical city source.
distributionDecisions.browser: The browser entrypoint references package JSON assets with import attributes; it no longer embeds a second copy of country, state, city, district, or coverage data.
distributionDecisions.mcp: The MCP bundle reuses the Node runtime and the same compact city asset.
distributionDecisions.countryShards: Per-country shards remain deterministic repository/CDN artifacts but are excluded from the core npm package because shipping them beside the all-city compact asset would duplicate the dataset. A future optional shards package can publish them without changing the core API.
distributionDecisions.auditEvidence: Large verification evidence such as the 39 MB per-city Wikidata QID report remains available in the source repository and release artifacts, not in the runtime package.
